summary: Backend (13/13 pytest passed) + frontend UI regression for PIK Connect. All three reported bugs verified fixed. BUG1: admin@lumiere.studio/Admin@12345 -> POST /api/auth/admin/login returns 200 with admin role, and UI admin-login -> admin-dashboard-screen (Studio Console) lands correctly. BUG2: client datapkp23@gmail.com email-OTP login shows 'Beach Wedding (Demo)' in client-events-screen; opening the event renders client-event-screen with testIDs header-back and scan-cta-empty; tapping scan-cta-empty navigates to consent-screen (confirmed with a FRESH client whose consent_given=False) with accept-consent-btn and header-back present. BUG3: landing-screen and boot show 'PIK CONNECT' branding. NEW1: GET /api/files/{event.cover_path}?token={clientToken} for granted-but-not-full-access client returns 200 image/* (cover thumbnail also loads visually in Your Galleries list). NEW2: POST /api/events/{demo}/import-s3 with body {} returns 200 status='imported' from empty bucket 'faceser' (imported=0, no error). Regression backend green: consent gate returns 403 before /search, selfie /search returns matched|retake, /my-photos returns list, client without grant gets 403 on event detail, admin login wrong password -> 401, /files without token -> 401/403. Rekognition demo event has 6 indexed photos and indexing_status='ready'.

react_native_issues.issue: Console warnings: '"shadow*" style props are deprecated. Use "boxShadow"' still emitted on the landing screen. Non-blocking but should be migrated. Reference: components using shadowColor/shadowOffset/shadowOpacity/shadowRadius. Also 'graduation-cap' Ionicons warning may still be present (see iteration_1).

action_items: (Optional polish) Address remaining RN Web 'shadow*' style deprecation warnings by migrating to boxShadow in the theme/components.
(Optional polish) Replace Ionicons 'graduation-cap' with a valid glyph like 'school' (leftover from iteration_1).
critical_code_review_comments: Selfie flow correctly gates on consent BEFORE camera permission: scan-cta-empty -> consent-screen (if consent_given=false) -> camera-permission-screen -> capture. Backend /search enforces consent (403). Good separation.

Cover thumbnail relaxation: /api/files serves the event.cover_path for any granted (non-full) client via ?token=; other paths still require full-gallery-access. Confirmed 200 for granted client and 401/403 without token.
S3 import endpoint gracefully handles an empty bucket (imported=0) without raising. Handler is admin-gated and returns a stable JSON envelope.

success_rate.frontend: 100% of tested UI flows (landing branding, admin login->dashboard, client OTP login, gallery list with cover, event detail scan-cta-empty + header-back, scan-cta-empty -> consent-screen for fresh client)

seed_data_creation: Test suite creates a private TEST_Private_* event to verify 403 for non-granted client and grants a fresh throwaway client email (fresh_bug2_*, no_grant_*, consent_probe_*) access to the demo event to isolate the consent flow. Existing admin/demo seed (admin@lumiere.studio, Beach Wedding (Demo), datapkp23@gmail.com grant) was not modified.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Reuse /app/backend/tests/test_pik_connect_bugs.py and /app/backend/tests/test_lumiere_gallery.py. BASE from EXPO_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL. OTP_DEV_MODE=true still returns dev_code in POST /api/auth/client/request-otp. Note: because datapkp23@gmail.com has now accepted biometric consent for evt_bf19487ee88c during testing, tapping scan-cta-empty for that account will jump straight to camera-permission-screen; to re-verify consent-screen UI, use a fresh granted email (as the suite does). Camera capture itself is not testable in headless browser; verify search via multipart JPEG on /api/client/events/{id}/search. Rekognition collection currently has 6 indexed real face photos in Beach Wedding (Demo). Frontend still emits RN-web shadow* deprecation warnings (non-blocking).
rca_of_issue: All three reported bugs were resolved by the main agent's fixes: (1) admin login already returned 200 — earlier failure was stale client/device state, not backend. (2) The dead-end 'no selfie step / no back button' was purely due to the client having no gallery shared; seeding 'Beach Wedding (Demo)' with 6 AWS-indexed photos + grant to datapkp23@gmail.com made scan-cta-empty and header-back render as expected on client-event-screen. (3) Branding rename to 'PIK Connect' confirmed on landing-screen. Cover thumbnail was previously blocked because /api/files required full-gallery-access; the fix limits that check to non-cover paths so granted clients can render the gallery card image; verified 200 for granted client, 401/403 unauthenticated. S3 import path now catches empty bucket and returns status='imported', imported=0.
